reviews.comment: This class has no exams, so the greater portion of your grade is from SD assignments and a few projects. The SD assignments take 1-4 hours. You only really need to watch her video lectures to be successful. The only thing that's a tossup is your Podcast project; pray you get a good group! The Podcast is a lot of work but fair.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a super nice professor. There are no tests, just projects, papers, and quizzes. If you do the work you will get a good grade

Dr. Sansom was very cool and pushed back due dates when needed. My only complaint is the group podcast is due at the end. It's just hard to do in an online class where some people live further away. On the bright side, this class has no exams. just group work, quizzes, and individual assignments.
Just make sure you read over all assignments

Dr. Sansom was by far the most amazing prof I've had. I took this for credit even though I'm in engineering, but I found this the most interesting class I have taken. Her lectures are asynchronous, but so fascinating that I eventually wanted to watch them rather than skim for quizzes. Saying I would HIGHLY recommend her is an understatement.

Dr. Sansom is super sweet and understanding! If you need and easy science credit take this class!! I literally made a 99. The work load can seem like a lot at first, there is a long group project where you make a podcast, but it was not bad at all. There is about 2 long essays you have to write but she's really lenient on deadlines. Also no test!!

You can get an A if you put in the work. There are a few papers you have to write, but if you breaking it up (100 words per day), you get it done. There are weekly quizzes that coincide with lectures. The majority of your grade is a group podcast. Just show up for the group meeting bc they're recorded. Overall, great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class itself isn't hard, but there is a lot of material. Expect 4 major essays, a semester-long podcast project, and 5 meetings with your group for it. Lectures are prerecorded and relatively short- if you take notes you should ace the quizzes. She really wants your success- only -1% penalty for late work up to 5 days. You get what you put in.

Don't let anyone convince you that this class is an Easy A. An A is definitely manageable, but there are so many lengthy assignments sprinkled in with weekly quizzes as well as a group project that lasts all semester which makes the class pretty exhausting. Do the extra reviews for extra credit and hope you get a good group and you will be fine

She has just thrown material for students to read. Her Async class has no meetings and she has so much stuff to read. One week you have two magazines to read each 45 pages long and also have to work on a group project, do quizzes, and also watch a video(s) as well as listen to podcasts and answer questions in a group forum. Its like 5 credit class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The asynchronous modules are so easy and you can get ahead quick. The only tough part is a mandatory group project that has weekday deadlines (instead of everything due on sunday). You are also supposed to listen to weekly podcasts but you can get by without it if you're smart. Also lots of graded group conversations, especially on the podcasts.

It's a pretty sweet class, and her and her TA are legit kind heroes. There's a group project and people do lag, but she grades on involvement and grades fairly. I hope I can take her class again! She's working on a podcast too, it sounds awesome!
If you are looking for an easy elective don't take this class. 5 papers with the lowest dropped. Tedious group project. Midterm and Final. Offers a lot of extra credit though.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Sansom is AMAZING. She is a very understanding professor. That being said, if you do the reviews, you should do well on exams -- they're almost word-for-word. Assignments are easy as long as you put in the effort and stay organized. This is one of the few classes I've never had to stress over. I highly recommend it, and Dr. Sansom!

This class had a lot of tedious work to be an easy A. She changed it from last semester. Overall, not the worst class as long as you keep up with the assignments and put effort into them. Everything was peer-graded, but she might be changing the program that we used.

This class was actually kind of difficult. For an online class, I was not expecting to meet with my group members EVERY week. We had to record our conversations as well and submit them. There are 4 writing assignments (essays), the fifth is dropped, midterm, a group podcast that will take the whole semester, and a final. Extra credit is available

There was a decent amount of writing and assignments but she was very flexible towards the end with due dates. Criteria on the project and some assignments was a little murky, that's my only gripe about her. Other than that I'd definitely recommend her and the class, it was quite interesting.
Was confused on requirements until I reached out. Helps to meet with her.
Talk to her if you ever have any issues with the class! She's a done a great job renovating the job and is very understanding and even throws in extra credit. You won't fail if you actually try.

Amazing class. Caring and wants you to pass. Had to recreate the whole online class and worked really hard to create it from the ground up. A little bit of effort goes a long way. Has all due dates in an online calendar. People who use group-me stress out about due dates, but look at the google calendar and it's not confusing at all.

Dr. Sansom is amazing! Doing research under her has been absolutely phenomenal and she truly cares about her students. She tries so much to make her classes as easy and understandable as possible. Try and you'll succeed!

The ratings on here really don't do Sansom justice. She had a rough start this semester, but has always been clear about what she wants from the students through the syllabus and even takes steps to clarify what has people confused in the GM. Her assignments are actually fun and interesting if you don't mind some work.

I greatly enjoyed this class and this professor so much that I joined this professor the next semester for research studies. She was understanding when I had a family conflict when turning in one of my papers and helped me out a lot. This class was a great experience and a lot of fun (even the group podcast).

this is the most confusing class ever. 4 papers but no specific requirements. they are peer graded. nothing is easy to locate on ecampus. if u ask questions on piazza, she will tell you to look on the syllabus which is not updated. lots of typos on all instructions. overall, do not take this class. take scsc 105 if you need a science credit
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: THE SETUP OF THE CLASS IS A TOTAL DISASTER! I have taken 4-5 online classes before and this class is the most garbage, confused class EVER! Everything is super hard to find and you don't know what is required for grade! Already dropped it!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is the most confusing class I have probably ever taken. Assignment directions are different depending on where you look (syllabus or Ecampus page), syllabus does not really help clarify anything. It is frustrating because the assignment is literally writing a paper but this course makes the requirements so unclear. Not worth the science credit
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Overall a really easy class but a lot of busy work. There are about 4 essays that are peer graded but the lowest grade is dropped. Also, there is a group podcast that is a semester long project. There are two in person tests but they are exactly the review. Tons of extra credit. She is a great professor and really wants her students to succeed.

This class isn't particularly hard, but its super confusing for no reason. The requirements (especially for the group podcast) are shady at best and somehow pretty much all my grades are A's, but my overall for the class is somehow still a B, class makes no sense to me.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Take this class if you need a core science credit. Dr. Sansom is extremely understanding and a great communicator. She wants students to do well and to learn something, which you do. If you do the work and remember to take the quizzes it should be a breeze. She is so kind and flexible.

i took her over the summer for GEOG 205 and she was great. She always responded to my e-mails quickly, worked with you and your grades and if you did the work you got the points. She's cool. Tests aren't that bad and the content is kind of fun because you get to give your own opinions.
easy A. Highly recommend this professor and course
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class was so easy! Modules are available from Day 1, so it's easy to get ahead and finish the class early. Assignments weren't too difficult, and the lowest quiz grade and assignment grade are dropped. Easy A!
